recall.minute: Preprocessing prepares raw data for learning. Start with attribute types (nominal, ordinal, interval, ratio; discrete or continuous) and data types. Check quality: noise, outliers, wrong or fake values, missing values and duplicates. Aggregate with split–apply–combine, clean inconsistencies, and impute gaps with an appropriate method. Detect outliers with Q1 − 1.5·IQR / Q3 + 1.5·IQR or μ ± 3σ. Split data into representative, stratified sets and rebalance rare classes in training only. Scale with min-max or z-scores fitted on training data, then engineer features through extraction, selection, construction, binning and encoding.
